## Schedule: daily 08:00 PKT
Cron `0 8 * * *` with timezone Asia/Karachi on the Schedule Trigger = 08:00 PKT every day (03:00 UTC).

## Sources (tested 21 Nov 2026)
- RemoteOK (https://remoteok.com/api): BLOCKED — 403 via egress proxy; request hangs in n8n without proxy.
- ArbeitNow (https://www.arbeitnow.com/api/job-board-api): UNREACHABLE from n8n — hangs without proxy; ECONNRESET with proxy (both egress identities).
- Remotive (https://remotive.com/api/remote-jobs): WORKS from n8n via explicit egress proxy (verified live test 21 Nov). Shipped config uses ArbeitNow without proxy pending an egress fix; switch the HTTP node URL to Remotive + set the proxy to go live now.
- The Code node accepts all three shapes: RemoteOK array, ArbeitNow {data:[...]}, Remotive {jobs:[...]}.
